[Compute Is the New Cash](https://every.)[Plus: The end of the AI subsidy, do you actually want to talk to your agent, and how to turn customer feedback into a product queue](https://every.) by [Laura Entis](https://every.)     Midjourney/Every illustration.  ‘AI & I’: How Stripe is building for an agent-native world A new episode of *[AI & I](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiQ29tcHV0ZSBJcyB0aGUgTmV3IENhc2giLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTQ5LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9wb2RjYXN0IiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjV9)* is here. **[Dan Shipper](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiQ29tcHV0ZSBJcyB0aGUgTmV3IENhc2giLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTQ5LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9AZGFuc2hpcHBlciIsInBvc2l0aW9uIjo2fQ==)** sits down with **Emily Glassberg Sands**, head of data and AI at Stripe, to discuss how AI is reshaping online commerce. Dan and Emily discuss how compute is the new cash, fraud has moved beyond the checkout, and agents are starting to act as economic participants on the internet.  Watch on [X](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiQ29tcHV0ZSBJcyB0aGUgTmV3IENhc2giLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTQ5LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9kYW5zaGlwcGVyL3N0YXR1cy8yMDQ5NTEyMTI5ODQ2NTMwMDg2IiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjd9) or [YouTube](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiQ29tcHV0ZSBJcyB0aGUgTmV3IENhc2giLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTQ5LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj0tZ095dXA2eUxCWSIsInBvc2l0aW9uIjo4fQ==), or listen on [Spotify](https://every.) or [Apple Podcasts](https://every.). You can also read the [transcript](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiQ29tcHV0ZSBJcyB0aGUgTmV3IENhc2giLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTQ5LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9wb2RjYXN0L3RyYW5zY3JpcHQtYS1sb29rLWluc2lkZS10aGUtYWdlbnQtZWNvbm9teSIsInBvc2l0aW9uIjoxMX0=).  Here are the highlights:   1. **The definition of fraud is expanding:** Fraud used to be about payments and stolen credit cards. Now AI companies also have to defend against attackers stealing tokens from free trials, credits, and unpaid compute bills. “Fraud is now a full-funnel problem, not a transaction problem alone,” says Glassberg Sands. 2. **AI is making fraud easier to execute and detect:** Fraudsters now have AI on their side, but so do the companies trying to stop them. AI services also have higher marginal costs than traditional SaaS, so stolen compute can be burned through quickly or resold. 3. **The internet needs to evolve:** Stripe was built for an internet where people browsed, filled out forms, and clicked checkout buttons. Now, humans act through AI interfaces, agents act for them, and software increasingly interacts directly with other software. Every layer of the stack has to adapt to these new behaviors. 4. **AI growth is still mostly new money:** The top AI companies on Stripe are reaching $30 million in annual recurring revenue [in about 18 months](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiQ29tcHV0ZSBJcyB0aGUgTmV3IENhc2giLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTQ5LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zdHJpcGUuY29tL2d1aWRlcy9pbmRleGluZy10aGUtYWktZWNvbm9teSIsInBvc2l0aW9uIjoxMn0=)—roughly three times faster than top SaaS companies from 2018. For now, that growth is largely net new spend rather than cannibalized software budgets, says Glassberg Sands. 5. **Agents are snapping up commodities:** Agentic commerce is real but still in its early stages, and focused on smaller purchases. People are more comfortable letting agents buy low-stakes, easily comparable items like Halloween costumes or school supplies than letting them book a summer trip or order an expensive couch.
